tally.citation: Epic AC 1 claims runaway aborts route to 'verdict built from fresh per-criterion evidence'; this bug shows bounded recovery fails entirely on single-criterion budget exhaustion, violating the fresh-evidence delivery promised by the actuator child.
tally.title: Bounded recovery dies whole when one criterion's evidence run exhausts its budget

tally.citation: Epic AC 1 claims runaway tool-call cycles are detected DURING the run and routed to fresh-evidence verdict; this bug describes the exact failure mode (131 consecutive identical tool calls burning budget) that the epic's detector and actuator must prevent.
tally.title: Completion verifier burns its whole step budget re-issuing one identical tool call

tally.citation: Epic AC 4 requires 'gate runs record request and tool-call usage durably by default' — sidecar channel drops `requests` and `tool_calls` fields despite computing them, violating the durable recording requirement.
tally.title: The sidecar channel records gate-run limits but not gate-run consumption

tally.citation: Epic AC 4 claims 'gate runs record request and tool-call usage durably by default' — this bug documents that tool_calls are not recorded at all and usage_log is opt-in (env var unset by default), directly blocking the tuning and instrumentation the epic promised.
tally.title: Gate spend is never durably recorded: per-run request/tool-call counts unavailable after the fact

tally.citation: Epic AC#1 claims 'every child story is closed and certified' but the verifier receives zero evidence of the deterministically-computed child_closure_findings proof, causing false FAILs on satisfied criteria.
tally.title: Child-closure proof is computed deterministically then hidden from the completion verifier

tally.citation: Epic AC 1 claims runaway tool-call cycles are detected and routed to fresh verdict; this bug describes the root cause of the loop (search_files silent failure on file paths) that the epic's detector and actuator must catch and break.
tally.title: Completion gate cannot verify a 59-descendant epic: step budget exhausts at 480 and at 1600, leaving --force-close as the only exit

tally.citation: Bug describes plan-review material canonicalization and close-gate stale-material detection; epic addresses tool-call loop detection and bounded recovery in the completion-verification step — different subsystems and concerns.
tally.title: Whitespace-only description edits must not invalidate plan-review material
